scope: Pre-frozen 64 train discovery, stratified 16 each: exploratory, not unbiased accuracy or holdout; R-only L18 residual perturbation changes Q/K/V and residual jointly. Test effects were not used to select this sample. Fixedwrong is K1 native best wrong. No group selection or re-fitting.
